If you are running riverbed 1.8.0, upgrade to 1.8.1 today.

**What happened.** Under a retry, 1.8.0 can write the same checkpoint twice. 1.8.1 fixes this.

**What to do.** The upgrade is a drop-in pip install. There is no data loss and no config change.

```
pip install -U riverbed
```

That is the whole fix. Nothing else to migrate or restart beyond your normal deploy.

Questions or something that looks off after upgrading? Reply to this email and the riverbed team will pick it up.

Thanks for running riverbed,
The Tessera Labs team
